# NEW 2026-11-17 conquest campaigns (phase 1 + 2). Generated by gen_heg_campaigns.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ======================== 埃及 ========================
# BYZ scope. Launch: pay, declare on every country with its capital in the region, start the campaign.
oe_hc_egypt_start = {
    add_gold = { value = oe_hc_declare_cost multiply = -1 }
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -10 } }
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target } remove_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target }
    every_current_war = { remove_variable = oe_hc_egypt_war }
    every_country = {
        limit = { oe_hc_egypt_target = yes }
        set_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target
        add_to_list = oe_hc_egypt_targets
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_egypt_targets
        save_scope_as = oe_hc_enemy
        c:BYZ = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_hc_enemy } }
                add_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
                declare_war_with_cb = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
            }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_egypt_targets
        every_current_war = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { is_an_attacker = c:BYZ is_a_defender = prev }
                    AND = { is_a_defender = c:BYZ is_an_attacker = prev }
                }
            }
            set_variable = oe_hc_egypt_war
        }
    }
    # Native diplomacy may refuse a declaration: refund when no campaign war exists (hidden, so the
    # effect preview does not show a +1000 gold line next to the cost).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_egypt_target_active = yes } } }
        hidden_effect = {
            add_gold = oe_hc_declare_cost
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = 10 } }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_progress value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_pressure value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_bonus value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_months value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
        if = { limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_hc_egypt } } activate_situation = situation:oe_hc_egypt }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.100
        oe_hcr_egypt_on_start = yes
        oe_tmc_on_start = { r = egypt }
        oe_tsn_on_campaign_start = yes  # territory rework: senate vote on the war levy (gen_territory_senate.py)
        oe_tm_alliance_muster = yes  # territory rework: alliance contingents (gen_territory_middle.py)
    }
}

# Location scope (occupation and siege hooks).
oe_hc_egypt_capture = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_hc_egypt_capture_allowed = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_gain value = 1 }
        oe_transfer_conquest_without_core = { recipient = c:BYZ }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Event bonus to progress, clamped to ±20.
oe_hc_egypt_add_bonus = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_bonus add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_bonus min = -20 max = 20 }
}
oe_hc_egypt_add_pressure = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_pressure add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# BYZ scope. Monthly tick while the campaign runs.
oe_hc_egypt_monthly = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_months add = 1 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_pressure add = 2 }
    # 复兴狂热“狂热”档：压力每月 −1（罗马再征服总局势）
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 4 } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_pressure add = -1 } }
    # 尼罗河汛期：7–9 月压力每月额外 +2
    if = { limit = { OR = { current_month = 7 current_month = 8 current_month = 9 } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_pressure add = 2 } }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_egypt_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
    # Progress: key cities held or occupied × 60 + region locations owned × 40 + event bonus.
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { location:alexandria = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:cairo = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:damietta = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:asyut = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:aswan = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 0 }
    region:egypt_region = {
        every_location_in_region = {
            limit = { is_ownable = yes }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own add = 1 } } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_tmp_all < 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 1 } }
    set_variable = {
        name = oe_hc_egypt_progress
        value = {
            value = var:oe_hc_tmp_keys
            multiply = 60
            divide = 5
            add = { value = var:oe_hc_tmp_own multiply = 40 divide = var:oe_hc_tmp_all }
            add = var:oe_hc_egypt_bonus
            min = 0
            max = 100
            round = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_ms_alexandria } location:alexandria = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hc_egypt_ms_alexandria
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.11
    }
    oe_hcr_egypt_monthly = yes
    random = {
        chance = 10
        random_list = {
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.1 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.2 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.3 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.4 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_12 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_12 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.12 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_13 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_13 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.13 }
                30 = { }
        }
    }
    # Endings
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_egypt_progress >= 80 }
        oe_hc_egypt_end = { outcome = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_egypt_pressure >= 100 }
        oe_hc_egypt_end = { outcome = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                var:oe_hc_egypt_months >= 120
                NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_egypt_target_active = yes } }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_egypt_progress >= 40 } oe_hc_egypt_end = { outcome = 2 } }
        else = { oe_hc_egypt_end = { outcome = 3 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. outcome: 1 victory, 2 negotiated peace, 3 defeat.
oe_hc_egypt_end = {
    save_scope_as = oe_hc_byz
    every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_war } add_to_list = oe_hc_egypt_wars_to_end }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_egypt_wars_to_end
        remove_variable = oe_hc_egypt_war
        scope:oe_hc_byz = { white_peace = prev }
    }
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target } remove_variable = oe_hc_egypt_target }
    remove_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active
    remove_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_last_region value = 1 }
    # Dispatch by name instead of comparing a variable set in the same block: tooltip passes (console, actions)
    # evaluate limits without running set_variable and log "variable not set" errors.
    oe_hc_egypt_end_$outcome$ = yes
}

    set_variable = oe_hc_egypt_won
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = 15 }

    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.101
    oe_hcr_schedule_revolt = { idx = 1 }

# BYZ scope. Monthly tick while the campaign runs.
oe_hc_africa_monthly = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_africa_months add = 1 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_africa_pressure add = 2 }
    # 复兴狂热“狂热”档：压力每月 −1（罗马再征服总局势）
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 4 } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_africa_pressure add = -1 } }
    # 内陆补给：本次战役新得地点里内陆多于沿海时，压力每月额外 +1
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_in value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_co value = 0 }
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_gain ?= 2 }
        if = { limit = { is_coastal = yes } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_co add = 1 } } }
        else = { c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_in add = 1 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_tmp_in > var:oe_hc_tmp_co } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_africa_pressure add = 1 } }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_africa_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
    # Progress: key cities held or occupied × 60 + region locations owned × 40 + event bonus.
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { location:tripoli = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:tunis = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:kairouan = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:mahdia = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:annaba = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:bejaia = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:algiers = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 0 }
    region:maghreb_region = {
        every_location_in_region = {
            limit = { is_ownable = yes }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own add = 1 } } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_tmp_all < 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 1 } }
    set_variable = {
        name = oe_hc_africa_progress
        value = {
            value = var:oe_hc_tmp_keys
            multiply = 60
            divide = 7
            add = { value = var:oe_hc_tmp_own multiply = 40 divide = var:oe_hc_tmp_all }
            add = var:oe_hc_africa_bonus
            min = 0
            max = 100
            round = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_ms_tunis } location:tunis = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hc_africa_ms_tunis
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.23
    }
    oe_hcr_africa_monthly = yes
    random = {
        chance = 10
        random_list = {
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.1 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.2 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.3 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.4 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_21 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_21 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.21 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_22 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_22 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.22 }
                30 = { }
        }
    }
    # Endings
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_africa_progress >= 80 }
        oe_hc_africa_end = { outcome = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_africa_pressure >= 100 }
        oe_hc_africa_end = { outcome = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                var:oe_hc_africa_months >= 120
                NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_africa_target_active = yes } }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_africa_progress >= 40 } oe_hc_africa_end = { outcome = 2 } }
        else = { oe_hc_africa_end = { outcome = 3 } }
    }
}

    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_target } remove_variable = oe_hc_italy_target }
    every_current_war = { remove_variable = oe_hc_italy_war }
    every_country = {
        limit = { oe_hc_italy_target = yes }
        set_variable = oe_hc_italy_target
        add_to_list = oe_hc_italy_targets
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_italy_targets
        save_scope_as = oe_hc_enemy
        c:BYZ = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_hc_enemy } }
                add_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
                declare_war_with_cb = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
            }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_italy_targets
        every_current_war = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { is_an_attacker = c:BYZ is_a_defender = prev }
                    AND = { is_a_defender = c:BYZ is_an_attacker = prev }
                }
            }
            set_variable = oe_hc_italy_war
        }
    }
    # Native diplomacy may refuse a declaration: refund when no campaign war exists (hidden, so the
    # effect preview does not show a +1000 gold line next to the cost).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_italy_target_active = yes } } }
        hidden_effect = {
            add_gold = oe_hc_declare_cost
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = 10 } }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = oe_hc_italy_active
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_progress value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_pressure value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_bonus value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_months value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
        if = { limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_hc_italy } } activate_situation = situation:oe_hc_italy }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.100
        oe_hcr_italy_on_start = yes
        oe_tmc_on_start = { r = italy }
        oe_tsn_on_campaign_start = yes  # territory rework: senate vote on the war levy (gen_territory_senate.py)
        oe_tm_alliance_muster = yes  # territory rework: alliance contingents (gen_territory_middle.py)
    }
}

# Location scope (occupation and siege hooks).
oe_hc_italy_capture = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_hc_italy_capture_allowed = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_gain value = 3 }
        oe_transfer_conquest_without_core = { recipient = c:BYZ }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Event bonus to progress, clamped to ±20.
oe_hc_italy_add_bonus = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_bonus add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_bonus min = -20 max = 20 }
}
oe_hc_italy_add_pressure = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_pressure add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# BYZ scope. Monthly tick while the campaign runs.
oe_hc_italy_monthly = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_months add = 1 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_pressure add = 2 }
    # 复兴狂热“狂热”档：压力每月 −1（罗马再征服总局势）
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 4 } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_pressure add = -1 } }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
    # Progress: key cities held or occupied × 60 + region locations owned × 40 + event bonus.
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { location:rome = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:naples = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:ravenna = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:bari = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:palermo = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:florence = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:ancona = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 0 }
    region:italy_region = {
        every_location_in_region = {
            limit = { is_ownable = yes }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own add = 1 } } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_tmp_all < 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 1 } }
    set_variable = {
        name = oe_hc_italy_progress
        value = {
            value = var:oe_hc_tmp_keys
            multiply = 60
            divide = 7
            add = { value = var:oe_hc_tmp_own multiply = 40 divide = var:oe_hc_tmp_all }
            add = var:oe_hc_italy_bonus
            min = 0
            max = 100
            round = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_ms_rome } location:rome = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hc_italy_ms_rome
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.31
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_ms_bari } location:bari = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hc_italy_ms_bari
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.33
    }
    oe_hcr_italy_monthly = yes
    random = {
        chance = 10
        random_list = {
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.1 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.2 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.3 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.4 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_32 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_32 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.32 }
                30 = { }
        }
    }
    # Endings
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_italy_progress >= 80 }
        oe_hc_italy_end = { outcome = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_italy_pressure >= 100 }
        oe_hc_italy_end = { outcome = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                var:oe_hc_italy_months >= 120
                NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_italy_target_active = yes } }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_italy_progress >= 40 } oe_hc_italy_end = { outcome = 2 } }
        else = { oe_hc_italy_end = { outcome = 3 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. outcome: 1 victory, 2 negotiated peace, 3 defeat.
oe_hc_italy_end = {
    save_scope_as = oe_hc_byz
    every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_war } add_to_list = oe_hc_italy_wars_to_end }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_italy_wars_to_end
        remove_variable = oe_hc_italy_war
        scope:oe_hc_byz = { white_peace = prev }
    }
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_target } remove_variable = oe_hc_italy_target }
    remove_variable = oe_hc_italy_active
    remove_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_last_region value = 3 }
    # Dispatch by name instead of comparing a variable set in the same block: tooltip passes (console, actions)
    # evaluate limits without running set_variable and log "variable not set" errors.
    oe_hc_italy_end_$outcome$ = yes
}
oe_hc_italy_end_1 = {
    set_variable = oe_hc_italy_won
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = 15 }
    oe_rr_region_restored = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.101
    oe_hcr_schedule_revolt = { idx = 3 }
    oe_tmc_on_end = { r = italy outcome = 1 }
}
oe_hc_italy_end_2 = {
    set_variable = oe_hc_italy_won
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = 8 }
    oe_rr_region_restored = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.102
    oe_hcr_schedule_revolt = { idx = 3 }
    oe_tmc_on_end = { r = italy outcome = 2 }
}
oe_hc_italy_end_3 = {
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = -15 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_italy_cd years = 10 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.103
    oe_tmc_on_end = { r = italy outcome = 3 }
}

# BYZ scope. Launch: pay, declare on every country with its capital in the region, start the campaign.
oe_hc_france_start = {
    add_gold = { value = oe_hc_declare_cost multiply = -1 }
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -10 } }
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_target } remove_variable = oe_hc_france_target }
    every_current_war = { remove_variable = oe_hc_france_war }
    every_country = {
        limit = { oe_hc_france_target = yes }
        set_variable = oe_hc_france_target

                declare_war_with_cb = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
            }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_france_targets
        every_current_war = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { is_an_attacker = c:BYZ is_a_defender = prev }
                    AND = { is_a_defender = c:BYZ is_an_attacker = prev }
                }
            }
            set_variable = oe_hc_france_war
        }
    }
    # Native diplomacy may refuse a declaration: refund when no campaign war exists (hidden, so the
    # effect preview does not show a +1000 gold line next to the cost).

        limit = { NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_france_target_active = yes } } }
        hidden_effect = {
            add_gold = oe_hc_declare_cost
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = 10 } }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = oe_hc_france_active
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_progress value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_pressure value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_bonus value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_months value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
        if = { limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_hc_france } } activate_situation = situation:oe_hc_france }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.100
        oe_hcr_france_on_start = yes
        oe_tmc_on_start = { r = france }
        oe_tsn_on_campaign_start = yes  # territory rework: senate vote on the war levy (gen_territory_senate.py)
        oe_tm_alliance_muster = yes  # territory rework: alliance contingents (gen_territory_middle.py)
    }
}

    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_bonus add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_bonus min = -20 max = 20 }
}
oe_hc_france_add_pressure = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_pressure add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# BYZ scope. Monthly tick while the campaign runs.
oe_hc_france_monthly = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_months add = 1 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_pressure add = 2 }
    # 复兴狂热“狂热”档：压力每月 −1（罗马再征服总局势）
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 4 } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_pressure add = -1 } }
    # 北方冬营：12–2 月压力每月额外 +1
    if = { limit = { OR = { current_month = 12 current_month = 1 current_month = 2 } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_pressure add = 1 } }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_france_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
    # Progress: key cities held or occupied × 60 + region locations owned × 40 + event bonus.
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { location:paris = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:lyon = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:marseille = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:bordeaux = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:toulouse = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:rouen = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:orleans = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 0 }
    region:france_region = {
        every_location_in_region = {
            limit = { is_ownable = yes }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own add = 1 } } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_tmp_all < 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 1 } }
    set_variable = {
        name = oe_hc_france_progress
        value = {
            value = var:oe_hc_tmp_keys
            multiply = 60
            divide = 7
            add = { value = var:oe_hc_tmp_own multiply = 40 divide = var:oe_hc_tmp_all }
            add = var:oe_hc_france_bonus
            min = 0
            max = 100
            round = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_ms_paris } location:paris = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hc_france_ms_paris
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.43
    }
    oe_hcr_france_monthly = yes
    random = {
        chance = 10
        random_list = {
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.1 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.2 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.3 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.4 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_41 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_41 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.41 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_42 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_42 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.42 }
                30 = { }
        }
    }
    # Endings
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_france_progress >= 80 }
        oe_hc_france_end = { outcome = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_france_pressure >= 100 }
        oe_hc_france_end = { outcome = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                var:oe_hc_france_months >= 120
                NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_france_target_active = yes } }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_france_progress >= 40 } oe_hc_france_end = { outcome = 2 } }
        else = { oe_hc_france_end = { outcome = 3 } }
    }
}

# ======================== 伊比利亚 ========================
# BYZ scope. Launch: pay, declare on every country with its capital in the region, start the campaign.
oe_hc_iberia_start = {
    add_gold = { value = oe_hc_declare_cost multiply = -1 }
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -10 } }
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_target } remove_variable = oe_hc_iberia_target }
    every_current_war = { remove_variable = oe_hc_iberia_war }
    every_country = {
        limit = { oe_hc_iberia_target = yes }
        set_variable = oe_hc_iberia_target
        add_to_list = oe_hc_iberia_targets
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_iberia_targets
        save_scope_as = oe_hc_enemy
        c:BYZ = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_hc_enemy } }
                add_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
                declare_war_with_cb = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
            }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_iberia_targets
        every_current_war = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { is_an_attacker = c:BYZ is_a_defender = prev }
                    AND = { is_a_defender = c:BYZ is_an_attacker = prev }
                }
            }
            set_variable = oe_hc_iberia_war
        }
    }
    # Native diplomacy may refuse a declaration: refund when no campaign war exists (hidden, so the
    # effect preview does not show a +1000 gold line next to the cost).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_iberia_target_active = yes } } }
        hidden_effect = {
            add_gold = oe_hc_declare_cost
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = 10 } }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_progress value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_pressure value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_bonus value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_months value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
        if = { limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_hc_iberia } } activate_situation = situation:oe_hc_iberia }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.100
        oe_hcr_iberia_on_start = yes
        oe_tmc_on_start = { r = iberia }
        oe_tsn_on_campaign_start = yes  # territory rework: senate vote on the war levy (gen_territory_senate.py)
        oe_tm_alliance_muster = yes  # territory rework: alliance contingents (gen_territory_middle.py)
    }
}

# Location scope (occupation and siege hooks).
oe_hc_iberia_capture = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_hc_iberia_capture_allowed = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_gain value = 5 }
        oe_transfer_conquest_without_core = { recipient = c:BYZ }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Event bonus to progress, clamped to ±20.
oe_hc_iberia_add_bonus = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_bonus add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_bonus min = -20 max = 20 }
}
oe_hc_iberia_add_pressure = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_pressure add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# BYZ scope. Monthly tick while the campaign runs.
oe_hc_iberia_monthly = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_months add = 1 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_pressure add = 2 }
    # 复兴狂热“狂热”档：压力每月 −1（罗马再征服总局势）
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 4 } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_pressure add = -1 } }
    # 斯帕尼亚旧港：帝国集团占有 cartagena 时压力每月 −1
    if = { limit = { location:cartagena = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_pressure add = -1 } }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
    # Progress: key cities held or occupied × 60 + region locations owned × 40 + event bonus.
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { location:toledo = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:sevilla = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:lisbon = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:barcelona = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:valencia = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:zaragoza = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:cordoba = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:granada = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 0 }
    region:iberia_region = {
        every_location_in_region = {
            limit = { is_ownable = yes }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own add = 1 } } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_tmp_all < 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 1 } }
    set_variable = {
        name = oe_hc_iberia_progress
        value = {
            value = var:oe_hc_tmp_keys
            multiply = 60
            divide = 8
            add = { value = var:oe_hc_tmp_own multiply = 40 divide = var:oe_hc_tmp_all }
            add = var:oe_hc_iberia_bonus
            min = 0
            max = 100
            round = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_ms_toledo } location:toledo = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hc_iberia_ms_toledo
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.53
    }
    oe_hcr_iberia_monthly = yes
    random = {
        chance = 10
        random_list = {
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.1 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.2 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.3 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.4 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_51 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_51 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.51 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_52 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_52 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.52 }
                30 = { }
        }
    }
    # Endings
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_iberia_progress >= 80 }
        oe_hc_iberia_end = { outcome = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_iberia_pressure >= 100 }
        oe_hc_iberia_end = { outcome = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                var:oe_hc_iberia_months >= 120
                NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_iberia_target_active = yes } }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_iberia_progress >= 40 } oe_hc_iberia_end = { outcome = 2 } }
        else = { oe_hc_iberia_end = { outcome = 3 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. outcome: 1 victory, 2 negotiated peace, 3 defeat.
oe_hc_iberia_end = {
    save_scope_as = oe_hc_byz
    every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_war } add_to_list = oe_hc_iberia_wars_to_end }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_iberia_wars_to_end
        remove_variable = oe_hc_iberia_war
        scope:oe_hc_byz = { white_peace = prev }
    }
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_target } remove_variable = oe_hc_iberia_target }
    remove_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active
    remove_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_last_region value = 5 }
    # Dispatch by name instead of comparing a variable set in the same block: tooltip passes (console, actions)
    # evaluate limits without running set_variable and log "variable not set" errors.
    oe_hc_iberia_end_$outcome$ = yes
}
oe_hc_iberia_end_1 = {
    set_variable = oe_hc_iberia_won
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = 15 }
    oe_rr_region_restored = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.101
    oe_hcr_schedule_revolt = { idx = 5 }
    oe_tmc_on_end = { r = iberia outcome = 1 }
}
oe_hc_iberia_end_2 = {
    set_variable = oe_hc_iberia_won
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = 8 }
    oe_rr_region_restored = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.102
    oe_hcr_schedule_revolt = { idx = 5 }
    oe_tmc_on_end = { r = iberia outcome = 2 }
}
oe_hc_iberia_end_3 = {
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = -15 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_iberia_cd years = 10 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.103
    oe_tmc_on_end = { r = iberia outcome = 3 }
}

# ======================== 不列颠 ========================
# BYZ scope. Launch: pay, declare on every country with its capital in the region, start the campaign.
oe_hc_britain_start = {
    add_gold = { value = oe_hc_declare_cost multiply = -1 }
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -10 } }
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_target } remove_variable = oe_hc_britain_target }
    every_current_war = { remove_variable = oe_hc_britain_war }
    every_country = {
        limit = { oe_hc_britain_target = yes }
        set_variable = oe_hc_britain_target
        add_to_list = oe_hc_britain_targets
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_britain_targets
        save_scope_as = oe_hc_enemy
        c:BYZ = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_hc_enemy } }
                add_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
                declare_war_with_cb = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
            }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_britain_targets
        every_current_war = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { is_an_attacker = c:BYZ is_a_defender = prev }
                    AND = { is_a_defender = c:BYZ is_an_attacker = prev }
                }
            }
            set_variable = oe_hc_britain_war
        }
    }
    # Native diplomacy may refuse a declaration: refund when no campaign war exists (hidden, so the
    # effect preview does not show a +1000 gold line next to the cost).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_britain_target_active = yes } } }
        hidden_effect = {
            add_gold = oe_hc_declare_cost
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = 10 } }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = oe_hc_britain_active
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_britain_progress value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_britain_pressure value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_britain_bonus value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_britain_months value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
        if = { limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_hc_britain } } activate_situation = situation:oe_hc_britain }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.100
        oe_hcr_britain_on_start = yes
        oe_tmc_on_start = { r = britain }
        oe_tsn_on_campaign_start = yes  # territory rework: senate vote on the war levy (gen_territory_senate.py)
        oe_tm_alliance_muster = yes  # territory rework: alliance contingents (gen_territory_middle.py)
    }
}

# Location scope (occupation and siege hooks).
oe_hc_britain_capture = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_hc_britain_capture_allowed = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_gain value = 6 }
        oe_transfer_conquest_without_core = { recipient = c:BYZ }
    }
}

    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_britain_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }

# BYZ scope. Monthly tick while the campaign runs.
oe_hc_britain_monthly = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_britain_months add = 1 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_britain_pressure add = 2 }
    # 复兴狂热“狂热”档：压力每月 −1（罗马再征服总局势）
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 4 } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_britain_pressure add = -1 } }
    # 跨海补给：压力每月额外 +1
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_britain_pressure add = 1 }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_britain_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
    # Progress: key cities held or occupied × 60 + region locations owned × 40 + event bonus.
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { location:london = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:york = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:winchester = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:bristol = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:canterbury = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:lincoln = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 0 }
    region:great_britain_region = {
        every_location_in_region = {
            limit = { is_ownable = yes }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own add = 1 } } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_tmp_all < 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 1 } }
    set_variable = {
        name = oe_hc_britain_progress
        value = {
            value = var:oe_hc_tmp_keys
            multiply = 60
            divide = 6
            add = { value = var:oe_hc_tmp_own multiply = 40 divide = var:oe_hc_tmp_all }
            add = var:oe_hc_britain_bonus
            min = 0
            max = 100
            round = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_ms_london } location:london = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hc_britain_ms_london
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.63
    }
    oe_hcr_britain_monthly = yes
    random = {
        chance = 10
        random_list = {
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.1 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.2 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.3 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.4 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_61 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_61 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.61 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_62 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_62 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.62 }
                30 = { }
        }
    }
    # Endings
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_britain_progress >= 80 }
        oe_hc_britain_end = { outcome = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_britain_pressure >= 100 }
        oe_hc_britain_end = { outcome = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                var:oe_hc_britain_months >= 120
                NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_britain_target_active = yes } }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_britain_progress >= 40 } oe_hc_britain_end = { outcome = 2 } }
        else = { oe_hc_britain_end = { outcome = 3 } }
    }
}

# ======================== 波斯 ========================
# BYZ scope. Launch: pay, declare on every country with its capital in the region, start the campaign.
oe_hc_persia_start = {
    add_gold = { value = oe_hc_declare_cost multiply = -1 }
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -10 } }
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_target } remove_variable = oe_hc_persia_target }
    every_current_war = { remove_variable = oe_hc_persia_war }
    every_country = {
        limit = { oe_hc_persia_target = yes }
        set_variable = oe_hc_persia_target
        add_to_list = oe_hc_persia_targets
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_persia_targets
        save_scope_as = oe_hc_enemy
        c:BYZ = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_hc_enemy } }
                add_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
                declare_war_with_cb = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
            }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_persia_targets
        every_current_war = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { is_an_attacker = c:BYZ is_a_defender = prev }
                    AND = { is_a_defender = c:BYZ is_an_attacker = prev }
                }
            }
            set_variable = oe_hc_persia_war
        }
    }
    # Native diplomacy may refuse a declaration: refund when no campaign war exists (hidden, so the
    # effect preview does not show a +1000 gold line next to the cost).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_persia_target_active = yes } } }
        hidden_effect = {
            add_gold = oe_hc_declare_cost
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = 10 } }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = oe_hc_persia_active
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_progress value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_pressure value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_bonus value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_months value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
        if = { limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_hc_persia } } activate_situation = situation:oe_hc_persia }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.100
        oe_hcr_persia_on_start = yes
        oe_tmc_on_start = { r = persia }
        oe_tsn_on_campaign_start = yes  # territory rework: senate vote on the war levy (gen_territory_senate.py)
        oe_tm_alliance_muster = yes  # territory rework: alliance contingents (gen_territory_middle.py)
    }
}

# Location scope (occupation and siege hooks).
oe_hc_persia_capture = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_hc_persia_capture_allowed = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_gain value = 7 }
        oe_transfer_conquest_without_core = { recipient = c:BYZ }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Event bonus to progress, clamped to ±20.
oe_hc_persia_add_bonus = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_bonus add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_bonus min = -20 max = 20 }
}
oe_hc_persia_add_pressure = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_pressure add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# BYZ scope. Monthly tick while the campaign runs.
oe_hc_persia_monthly = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_months add = 1 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_pressure add = 2 }
    # 复兴狂热“狂热”档：压力每月 −1（罗马再征服总局势）
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 4 } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_pressure add = -1 } }
    # 两河夏热：6–8 月压力每月额外 +1
    if = { limit = { OR = { current_month = 6 current_month = 7 current_month = 8 } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_pressure add = 1 } }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
    # Progress: key cities held or occupied × 60 + region locations owned × 40 + event bonus.
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { location:baghdad = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:mosul = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:tabriz = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:hamadan = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:isfahan = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:shiraz = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 0 }
    region:persia_region = {
        every_location_in_region = {
            limit = { is_ownable = yes }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own add = 1 } } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_tmp_all < 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 1 } }
    set_variable = {
        name = oe_hc_persia_progress
        value = {
            value = var:oe_hc_tmp_keys
            multiply = 60
            divide = 6
            add = { value = var:oe_hc_tmp_own multiply = 40 divide = var:oe_hc_tmp_all }
            add = var:oe_hc_persia_bonus
            min = 0
            max = 100
            round = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_ms_baghdad } location:baghdad = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hc_persia_ms_baghdad
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.73
    }
    oe_hcr_persia_monthly = yes
    random = {
        chance = 10
        random_list = {
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.1 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.2 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.3 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.4 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_71 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_71 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.71 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_72 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_72 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.72 }
                30 = { }
        }
    }
    # Endings
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_persia_progress >= 80 }
        oe_hc_persia_end = { outcome = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_persia_pressure >= 100 }
        oe_hc_persia_end = { outcome = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                var:oe_hc_persia_months >= 120
                NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_persia_target_active = yes } }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_persia_progress >= 40 } oe_hc_persia_end = { outcome = 2 } }
        else = { oe_hc_persia_end = { outcome = 3 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. outcome: 1 victory, 2 negotiated peace, 3 defeat.
oe_hc_persia_end = {
    save_scope_as = oe_hc_byz
    every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_war } add_to_list = oe_hc_persia_wars_to_end }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_persia_wars_to_end
        remove_variable = oe_hc_persia_war
        scope:oe_hc_byz = { white_peace = prev }
    }
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_target } remove_variable = oe_hc_persia_target }
    remove_variable = oe_hc_persia_active
    remove_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_last_region value = 7 }
    # Dispatch by name instead of comparing a variable set in the same block: tooltip passes (console, actions)
    # evaluate limits without running set_variable and log "variable not set" errors.
    oe_hc_persia_end_$outcome$ = yes
}
oe_hc_persia_end_1 = {
    set_variable = oe_hc_persia_won
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = 15 }
    oe_rr_region_restored = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.101
    oe_hcr_schedule_revolt = { idx = 7 }
    oe_tmc_on_end = { r = persia outcome = 1 }
}
oe_hc_persia_end_2 = {
    set_variable = oe_hc_persia_won
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = 8 }
    oe_rr_region_restored = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.102
    oe_hcr_schedule_revolt = { idx = 7 }
    oe_tmc_on_end = { r = persia outcome = 2 }
}
oe_hc_persia_end_3 = {
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = -15 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_persia_cd years = 10 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.103
    oe_tmc_on_end = { r = persia outcome = 3 }
}

# ======================== 黑海 ========================
# BYZ scope. Launch: pay, declare on every country with its capital in the region, start the campaign.
oe_hc_blacksea_start = {
    add_gold = { value = oe_hc_declare_cost multiply = -1 }
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -10 } }
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_target } remove_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_target }
    every_current_war = { remove_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_war }
    every_country = {
        limit = { oe_hc_blacksea_target = yes }
        set_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_target
        add_to_list = oe_hc_blacksea_targets
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_blacksea_targets
        save_scope_as = oe_hc_enemy
        c:BYZ = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_hc_enemy } }
                add_casus_belli = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
                declare_war_with_cb = { target = scope:oe_hc_enemy type = casus_belli:oe_heg_capital_invasion }
            }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_blacksea_targets
        every_current_war = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { is_an_attacker = c:BYZ is_a_defender = prev }
                    AND = { is_a_defender = c:BYZ is_an_attacker = prev }
                }
            }
            set_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_war
        }
    }
    # Native diplomacy may refuse a declaration: refund when no campaign war exists (hidden, so the
    # effect preview does not show a +1000 gold line next to the cost).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_blacksea_target_active = yes } } }
        hidden_effect = {
            add_gold = oe_hc_declare_cost
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = 10 } }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_blacksea_progress value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_blacksea_pressure value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_blacksea_bonus value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_blacksea_months value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
        if = { limit = { NOT = { is_situation_active = situation:oe_hc_blacksea } } activate_situation = situation:oe_hc_blacksea }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.100
        oe_hcr_blacksea_on_start = yes
        oe_tmc_on_start = { r = blacksea }
        oe_tsn_on_campaign_start = yes  # territory rework: senate vote on the war levy (gen_territory_senate.py)
        oe_tm_alliance_muster = yes  # territory rework: alliance contingents (gen_territory_middle.py)
    }
}

# Location scope (occupation and siege hooks).
oe_hc_blacksea_capture = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_hc_blacksea_capture_allowed = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_hc_gain value = 8 }
        oe_transfer_conquest_without_core = { recipient = c:BYZ }
    }
}

    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_blacksea_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }

# BYZ scope. Monthly tick while the campaign runs.
oe_hc_blacksea_monthly = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_blacksea_months add = 1 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_blacksea_pressure add = 2 }
    # 复兴狂热“狂热”档：压力每月 −1（罗马再征服总局势）
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 4 } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_blacksea_pressure add = -1 } }
    # 草原冬季：12–2 月压力每月额外 +2
    if = { limit = { OR = { current_month = 12 current_month = 1 current_month = 2 } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_blacksea_pressure add = 2 } }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_blacksea_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
    # Progress: key cities held or occupied × 60 + region locations owned × 40 + event bonus.
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { location:kaffa = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:soldaia = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:tana = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:astrakhan = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:solkhat = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 0 }
    region:steppes_region = {
        every_location_in_region = {
            limit = { is_ownable = yes }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own add = 1 } } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_tmp_all < 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 1 } }
    set_variable = {
        name = oe_hc_blacksea_progress
        value = {
            value = var:oe_hc_tmp_keys
            multiply = 60
            divide = 5
            add = { value = var:oe_hc_tmp_own multiply = 40 divide = var:oe_hc_tmp_all }
            add = var:oe_hc_blacksea_bonus
            min = 0
            max = 100
            round = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_ms_tana } location:tana = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_ms_tana
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.83
    }
    oe_hcr_blacksea_monthly = yes
    random = {
        chance = 10
        random_list = {
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.1 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.2 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.3 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.4 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_81 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_81 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.81 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_82 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_82 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.82 }
                30 = { }
        }
    }
    # Endings
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_blacksea_progress >= 80 }
        oe_hc_blacksea_end = { outcome = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_blacksea_pressure >= 100 }
        oe_hc_blacksea_end = { outcome = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                var:oe_hc_blacksea_months >= 120
                NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_blacksea_target_active = yes } }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_blacksea_progress >= 40 } oe_hc_blacksea_end = { outcome = 2 } }
        else = { oe_hc_blacksea_end = { outcome = 3 } }
    }
}
