    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_arabia_bonus min = -20 max = 20 }
}
oe_hc_arabia_add_pressure = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_arabia_pressure add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_arabia_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# BYZ scope. Monthly tick while the campaign runs.
oe_hc_arabia_monthly = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_arabia_months add = 1 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_hc_arabia_pressure add = 2 }
    # 复兴狂热“狂热”档：压力每月 −1（罗马再征服总局势）
    if = { limit = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 4 } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_arabia_pressure add = -1 } }
    # 内陆补给：本次战役新得地点里内陆多于沿海时，压力每月额外 +1
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_in value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_co value = 0 }
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_gain ?= 9 }
        if = { limit = { is_coastal = yes } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_co add = 1 } } }
        else = { c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_in add = 1 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_tmp_in > var:oe_hc_tmp_co } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_arabia_pressure add = 1 } }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_hc_arabia_pressure min = 0 max = 100 }
    # Progress: key cities held or occupied × 60 + region locations owned × 40 + event bonus.
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { location:mecca = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:medina = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:sana = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:adan = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:hail = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { location:masqat = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } } change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_keys add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 0 }
    region:arabia_region = {
        every_location_in_region = {
            limit = { is_ownable = yes }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_own add = 1 } } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_tmp_all < 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_tmp_all value = 1 } }
    set_variable = {
        name = oe_hc_arabia_progress
        value = {
            value = var:oe_hc_tmp_keys
            multiply = 60
            divide = 6
            add = { value = var:oe_hc_tmp_own multiply = 40 divide = var:oe_hc_tmp_all }
            add = var:oe_hc_arabia_bonus
            min = 0
            max = 100
            round = yes
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_ms_mecca } location:mecca = { OR = { owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } controller ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        set_variable = oe_hc_arabia_ms_mecca
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.93
    }
    oe_hcr_arabia_monthly = yes
    random = {
        chance = 10
        random_list = {
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_1 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.1 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_2 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.2 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_3 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.3 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_4 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.4 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_91 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_91 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.91 }
                10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_92 } } set_variable = { name = oe_hc_cd_oe_hc_92 years = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.92 }
                30 = { }
        }
    }
    # Endings
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_arabia_progress >= 80 }
        oe_hc_arabia_end = { outcome = 1 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_arabia_pressure >= 100 }
        oe_hc_arabia_end = { outcome = 3 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                var:oe_hc_arabia_months >= 120
                NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_arabia_target_active = yes } }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_hc_arabia_progress >= 40 } oe_hc_arabia_end = { outcome = 2 } }
        else = { oe_hc_arabia_end = { outcome = 3 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. outcome: 1 victory, 2 negotiated peace, 3 defeat.
oe_hc_arabia_end = {
    save_scope_as = oe_hc_byz
    every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_war } add_to_list = oe_hc_arabia_wars_to_end }
    every_in_list = {
        list = oe_hc_arabia_wars_to_end
        remove_variable = oe_hc_arabia_war
        scope:oe_hc_byz = { white_peace = prev }
    }
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_target } remove_variable = oe_hc_arabia_target }
    remove_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active
    remove_global_variable = oe_hc_any_active
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_last_region value = 9 }
    # Dispatch by name instead of comparing a variable set in the same block: tooltip passes (console, actions)
    # evaluate limits without running set_variable and log "variable not set" errors.
    oe_hc_arabia_end_$outcome$ = yes
}
oe_hc_arabia_end_1 = {
    set_variable = oe_hc_arabia_won
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = 15 }
    oe_rr_region_restored = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.101
    oe_hcr_schedule_revolt = { idx = 9 }
    oe_tmc_on_end = { r = arabia outcome = 1 }
}
oe_hc_arabia_end_2 = {
    set_variable = oe_hc_arabia_won
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = 8 }
    oe_rr_region_restored = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.102
    oe_hcr_schedule_revolt = { idx = 9 }
    oe_tmc_on_end = { r = arabia outcome = 2 }
}
oe_hc_arabia_end_3 = {
    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = -15 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_hc_arabia_cd years = 10 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_hc.103
    oe_tmc_on_end = { r = arabia outcome = 3 }
}

# ======================== shared ========================
# BYZ scope; var:oe_hc_last_region = 1/2/3. Saves the largest location gained in that campaign as scope:oe_hc_seat.
oe_hc_pick_seat = {
    ordered_owned_location = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_gain ?= root.var:oe_hc_last_region }
        order_by = population
        save_scope_as = oe_hc_seat
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Governance option 1: a theme seated at scope:oe_hc_seat, posts on every location gained in the campaign.
# Same founding steps as oe_theme_found_at_seat, without the historical-region data (distance band comes from
# oe_theme_admin_init, which measures the seat's distance to Constantinople).
oe_hc_found_theme = {
    scope:oe_hc_seat = {
        create_building_country_in_location = {
            religion = religion:orthodox
            culture = culture:oe_roman_noble_culture
            subject_type = subject_type:oe_empire_theme
            overlord = c:BYZ
            reforms = { oe_byz_theme_system_subject }
            hidden_effect = {
                change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
                change_heir_selection = heir_selection:oe_rome_province_elect
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_hc_theme
        }
        construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system_noble owner = scope:oe_hc_theme cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
    }
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_hc_theme
        international_organization_add_special_status = { type = special_status:oe_pillars_theme country = scope:oe_hc_theme }
    }
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = { var:oe_hc_gain ?= root.var:oe_hc_last_region }
        construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system owner = scope:oe_hc_theme cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
    }
    scope:oe_hc_seat = {
        while = { count = 3 create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_I owner = scope:oe_hc_theme } }
    }
    scope:oe_hc_theme = { set_gold = 300 add_manpower = 3 }
    # Historical name from the seat (gen_theme_names.py).
    scope:oe_hc_seat = { save_scope_as = oe_theme_name_seat }
    scope:oe_hc_theme = { oe_theme_apply_name = yes }
    # 2026-11-18 territory rework: land won in a campaign is governed as an exarchate (gen_territory_status.py).
    scope:oe_hc_theme = { oe_ts_set_status = { status = 3 } }
}

# BYZ scope. Governance option 3: hand the gained land to a new Roman-alliance subject seated at scope:oe_hc_seat.
oe_hc_make_ally = {
    scope:oe_hc_seat = {
        create_country_from_location = {
            overlord = c:BYZ
            subject_type = subject_type:oe_rome_sub
            save_scope_as = oe_hc_ally
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_hc_ally }
        every_owned_location = {
            limit = { var:oe_hc_gain ?= root.var:oe_hc_last_region }
            change_location_owner = scope:oe_hc_ally
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, yearly, AI Byzantium only: plan the next region in order, then launch when clearly stronger.
oe_hc_ai_yearly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg_egypt_plan_done } oe_heg_egypt_plan_allowed = yes gold >= 3000 }
        oe_heg_plan_egypt_effect = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg_africa_plan_done } oe_heg_africa_plan_allowed = yes gold >= 3000 }
        oe_heg_plan_africa_effect = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg_italy_plan_done } oe_heg_plan_italy_allowed = yes gold >= 3000 }
        oe_heg_plan_italy_effect = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg_france_plan_done } oe_heg_plan_france_allowed = yes gold >= 3000 }
        oe_heg_plan_france_effect = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg_iberia_plan_done } oe_heg_plan_iberia_allowed = yes gold >= 3000 }
        oe_heg_plan_iberia_effect = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg_britain_plan_done } oe_heg_plan_britain_allowed = yes gold >= 3000 }
        oe_heg_plan_britain_effect = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg_persia_plan_done } oe_heg_plan_persia_allowed = yes gold >= 3000 }
        oe_heg_plan_persia_effect = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg_black_sea_plan_done } oe_heg_plan_black_sea_allowed = yes gold >= 3000 }
        oe_heg_plan_black_sea_effect = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg_arabia_plan_done } oe_heg_plan_arabia_allowed = yes gold >= 3000 }
        oe_heg_plan_arabia_effect = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_hc_egypt_declare_allowed = yes
            gold >= 2000
            at_war = no
            NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_egypt_target = yes military_strength > { value = root.military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
        }
        oe_hc_egypt_start = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_hc_africa_declare_allowed = yes
            gold >= 2000
            at_war = no
            NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_africa_target = yes military_strength > { value = root.military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
        }
        oe_hc_africa_start = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_hc_italy_declare_allowed = yes
            gold >= 2000
            at_war = no
            NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_italy_target = yes military_strength > { value = root.military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
        }
        oe_hc_italy_start = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_hc_france_declare_allowed = yes
            gold >= 2000
            at_war = no
            NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_france_target = yes military_strength > { value = root.military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
        }
        oe_hc_france_start = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_hc_iberia_declare_allowed = yes
            gold >= 2000
            at_war = no
            NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_iberia_target = yes military_strength > { value = root.military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
        }
        oe_hc_iberia_start = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_hc_britain_declare_allowed = yes
            gold >= 2000
            at_war = no
            NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_britain_target = yes military_strength > { value = root.military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
        }
        oe_hc_britain_start = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_hc_persia_declare_allowed = yes
            gold >= 2000
            at_war = no
            NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_persia_target = yes military_strength > { value = root.military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
        }
        oe_hc_persia_start = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_hc_blacksea_declare_allowed = yes
            gold >= 2000
            at_war = no
            NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_blacksea_target = yes military_strength > { value = root.military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
        }
        oe_hc_blacksea_start = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_hc_arabia_declare_allowed = yes
            gold >= 2000
            at_war = no
            NOT = { any_country = { oe_hc_arabia_target = yes military_strength > { value = root.military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
        }
        oe_hc_arabia_start = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Roman Reconquest: fervour Rising (3) or Fervent (4) adds 2 to a positive event progress bonus.
oe_rr_bonus_extra = {
    if = { limit = { OR = { var:oe_rr_tier ?= 3 var:oe_rr_tier ?= 4 } } oe_hc_$r$_add_bonus = { amount = 2 } }
}
